_note: Every post is tagged with exactly one hook_type so the retro can learn which hooks win per platform. Templates are starting shapes, not copy to paste.

result_first.what: Show or state the finished result in the first line / first 2 seconds, then explain.
templates: Ye shot ek insaan ne banaya. Crew zero.
This Haryanvi scene took 40 minutes, start to finish.

constraint_number.what: A hard number that sounds impossible.
templates: 6 boliyan. 1 creator. Har hafte ek episode.

contrarian.what: A defensible take most people in the feed disagree with.
templates: AI promo editors ko replace nahi karega. Brief na likh paane wale editors ko karega.
Regional content needs better AI than English content, not cheaper AI.

failure_reveal.what: Open on a real failure, then the fix.
templates: Hanuman ji ka chehra har shot mein badal raha tha.
Our Bhojpuri lipsync was 300ms off. Here's what fixed it.

before_after.what: Storyboard or raw generation next to the final frame.
templates: Left: what the model gave me. Right: what went on air.
Pehle vs baad. Beech mein 4 tools.

insider_number.what: A cleared internal metric (needs STAGE comms approval).
templates: Completion rate on the Haryanvi cut beat the Hindi cut. Why:

story_open.what: First-person scene from the origin story.
